words.definition: worthy of praise; deserving approval
words.example: Helping a new student feel welcome is a commendable act.

words.definition: great damage or destruction
words.example: The storm left devastation across the small town.

words.definition: not complete; only part of something
words.example: The teacher gave us a partial list of the questions.

words.definition: to remember something
words.example: I can recall the story we read last week.

words.definition: good at finding clever ways to solve problems
words.example: The resourceful hikers made a shelter from branches.

words.definition: in a clear, bright, or detailed way
words.example: She vividly described the fireworks in the night sky.

words.definition: to make something stand out or seem stronger
words.example: The dark frame accentuates the bright painting.

words.definition: a person's usual mood, attitude, or nature
words.example: His cheerful disposition made everyone smile.

words.definition: great beauty or magnificence
words.example: The splendor of the palace amazed the visitors.

words.definition: a person or animal in a story, play, or movie
words.example: The main character learns an important lesson.

words.definition: to hold something tightly in place
words.example: Dad clamped the wood to the table before cutting it.

words.definition: to interest someone very much
words.example: The old legend fascinated the whole class.

words.definition: willing to give or share more than expected
words.example: Her generous friend shared his snack with everyone.

words.definition: juicy and tender; full of moisture
words.example: The succulent peach was sweet and fresh.

words.definition: careful about spending money or using resources
words.example: A thrifty shopper compares prices before buying.

words.definition: to think something is true without being sure
words.example: Do not assume the answer before you read the question.

words.definition: a feeling of thankfulness

words.definition: to succeed, grow, or do well
words.example: The small garden prospered in the warm sunshine.

words.definition: careless about danger or consequences
words.example: Riding a bike without looking is reckless.

words.definition: very hot
words.example: We stayed inside during the scorching afternoon.

words.definition: to dry up, shrink, or lose freshness
words.example: The flowers began to wither without water.
